en: A vintage, monochrome street scene showing a tree‑lined avenue with several children and adults standing and walking along the sidewalk. On the right are tall, ornate brick townhouses with wrought‑iron fences, likely upper‑class residences. The left side shows the continuation of the avenue receding into the distance. Printed red captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen" and "Waldeck Pyrmontsingel," and there is cursive handwriting over part of the sky and across the lower margin.
